page.overview:
Who is Enrico Pucci?

C-MOON Made in Heaven|alias=Father Pucci|gender=Male|occupation=Priest (formerly) Astronaut|status=Unknown (Sent into an infinite loop) |cod=Sent to an empty world for all of eternity via Gold Experience Requiem|noveldebut=JORGE JOESTAR Chapter 10: The H.G. Wells|nation=American|death=2012|namesake=Enrico Pucci (original counterpart)}}

Enrico Pucci (エンリコ・プッチ Enriko Pucchi) is a secondary antagonist featured in the light novel JORGE JOESTAR. He is an incarnate of Enrico Pucci, and lives in the 37th universe. He still wields the Stand Whitesnake, which later evolves into C-MOON and ultimately, Made in Heaven.

Before becoming an astronaut for , Pucci was an American priest working at Green Dolphin Street Prison.

Like his original counterpart, Pucci is a calm man, he maintains his notable hairstyle and sideburns. He wears a priest robe with shoulder pads on the shoulder cuffs.
